# What does a keynote have to cost for your speaking year to pay?

> Free speaker fee calculator: the keynote fee you need to hit an income goal after bureau commission and travel, plus a stacked quote with add-ons, virtual pricing and net per hour. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/speaker-fee-calculator/)
